stem: How is the information presented in the selection “Riding Out West” DIFFERENT from the information presented in the poem “Going Home” (Burlington Route)?

options.label: A
options.text: Only the selection uses details to describe the practical benefits of traveling by train.

options.label: B
options.text: Only the selection uses personal experiences to describe how people felt about using trains to travel.

options.label: C
options.text: Only the selection uses imagery to describe the experience of traveling by train.

options.label: D
options.text: Only the selection uses details to show where the trains travel.
